assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded CPT 93229
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197
The service was medically necessary to assess the recurrent dizziness and giddiness against the documented cardiac conditions
